programme.desc: This time we witness the turbulent beauty of Yellowstone National Park and the stunning fjords of Norway. We experience one of the world's greatest wildlife havens, Lake Bogoria in Kenya, East Africa, and explore Bryce Canyon.

programme.title: Animal Cops Houston
programme.desc: After arriving at an abandoned piece of property to rescue horses, Houston SPCA investigators find they must rescue puppies from a storm drain as well; large, aggressive, dangerous snakes run loose all over an amateur collector's house.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: The zoo staff work to build a relationship between a pair of Asian elephants with very different personalities. Vets treat an ocellated turkey chick's foot condition.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Tia sends Jake and Armando on a rescue mission to Texas, after hearing about two pit bulls who were wounded in a run-in with a porcupine. Then, a second story about a dog in death row comes in, the guys race to rescue him.

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: The team investigate a Texas swamp. The area is filled with snakes but what frightens Phil and Jess are mysterious lights that have haunted locals for decades.

programme.title: Mountain Monsters
programme.desc: A grisly discovery spurs the AIMS team to find out what monster lurks in the shadows of West Virginia's Tygart Valley. Using Trapper's journal, they devise an ingenious way to get footprints to help identify the mysterious predator.

programme.title: Animals On Drugs
programme.desc: In a methamphetamine hotspot, drugs seep into local waterways, creating aggressive alligators. Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante investigates the effects of meth on these reptiles and attempts to capture and rehabilitate a "meth gator."

programme.title: My Cat From Hell
programme.desc: Jackson must help a couple deal with two battling felines that have the house divided and are causing the couple's one-year-old daughter to be neglected; Achilles is threatening the peace between a couple who just started living together.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: A puppy is rescued from a kill shelter in Oklahoma. And a dog eats a box of toxic chocolates infused with marijuana, and is rushed to the clinic for treatment.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: The dive team have a tricky job adding a large fixture into a tank. And, the vets fix a penguin's broken leg, with hopes he can go back to the wild.

programme.title: Earth Wonders
programme.desc: This episode, we visit the barren icescape of the Columbia Icefield in the Canadian Rockies, and the site of Charles Darwin's big idea, the Galapagos Islands. We see the spectacular landscape of Glen Canyon.
